# HUNTYVERSE

**Explore. Hunt. Ride. Compete.**

Welcome to **HuntyVerse**, a VR hunting playground combining open-world exploration, multiplayer competition, customizable avatars, and fast-paced arcade action.

[media]

# 🌎 EXPLORE THE OPEN WORLD

Jump into a massive multiplayer Open World and explore a huge island filled with wildlife. Roam on foot or tear across the wilderness on an ATV while hunting ducks, turkeys, rabbits, and more.

[media]

# 👥 MULTIPLAYER & CUSTOMIZATION

Play online with up to 4 players and create your own hunter with customizable avatars and outfits. Explore together, race ATVs, hunt wildlife, or compete in The Hunt, where players race to find and hunt a list of animals. Get there fast, make your shots count, and finish first!

[media]

# 🦆 ORIGINAL ARCADE MODES

Want instant action? Jump into the original **HuntyVerse** arcade modes for quick, replayable VR hunting where speed, accuracy, and high scores take center stage.

Hunt ducks and deer, tackle challenges, compete with friends, and fight for your place on the leaderboards.

[media]

# 🔫 UNLOCK & COLLECT

Unlock guns, gloves, avatar outfits, and more. Discover collectible cards, complete dozens of achievements, and compete across multiple leaderboards.

Explore the wilderness. Hunt wildlife. Ride ATVs. Customize your hunter. Compete with friends.

[media]

# The hunt is bigger than ever. Welcome to HuntyVerse!
